title: Issue with button & ais-refinement-list
body:
Hi! I'm currently working with algolia/instantsearch and i would like checkbox buttons so i wrote this code :

```
<ais-refinement-list attribute-name="Source_type" :type="checkbox">
</ais-refinement-list>
```

but i have this in return :
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/31215695/29663352-edf7a6dc-88ca-11e7-932d-5baa9dfb5d68.png)

I'm suspecting a "-webkit-appearance" fault? Because when i'm in my console and i untick '-webkit-appearance=none' it worked...but when i deleted it in my  .css it didn't.
If you have any ideas or solutions ? Thank you.
